args.title: Add validation limits for report fields in API reference
args.body:
src/api/reports.ts

This update adds documentation to the API reference regarding the limits on report fields, including the maximum number of recipients (20), name length (120 characters), and categories (maximum of 50). This change helps users to understand the constraints when adding recipients and to mitigate validation errors by providing clear guidelines.
